title: Ashbury Rewards Folio-to-Points Reconciliation: Points Reversed on Removed Spend
content:
**Rule.** When a folio correction removes eligible spend from a stay already credited to an Ashbury Rewards account, the points reversed are defined as follows.

1. **Corrected stay and date.** The corrected stay is the stay of the folio that carries the latest adjustment posted on the member's folios, and the correction date is the posted date of that adjustment.
2. **Removed eligible spend.** The removed eligible spend is the adjustments on that folio posted against room, breakfast, food and beverage and spa charges.
3. **Credited rate and bonus ratio.** The credited rate of the stay is its posted base points divided by the eligible spend they were posted on, and its credited bonus ratio is its posted elite bonus divided by its posted base points, each rounded to four decimal places.
4. **Base points removed.** The base points removed are the removed eligible spend times the credited rate, rounded down to a whole point.
5. **Elite bonus removed.** The elite bonus removed is the base points of the bonus-bearing spend, which are that spend times the credited rate rounded down to a whole point, times the credited bonus ratio, rounded down to a whole point. The bonus-bearing spend is the whole removed eligible spend.
6. **Points reversed.** The computed reversal is the base points removed plus the elite bonus removed, and the points reversed are the computed reversal, a whole number of points.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays)

| Line | Stay A | Stay B |
|---|---|---|
| Posted base points, on eligible spend of | 6600 on 660.00 USD | 4123 on 412.37 USD |
| Posted elite bonus | 1650 | 1030 |
| Credited rate (item 3) | 10.0000 | 9.9983 |
| Credited bonus ratio (item 3) | 0.2500 | 0.2498 |
| Removed eligible spend (item 2) | 120.00 room | 45.50 spa |
| Base points removed (item 4) | 1200 | 454.92, rounded down to 454 |
| Elite bonus removed (item 5) | 1200 times 0.25 is 300 | 454 times 0.2498 is 113.41, rounded down to 113 |
| Points reversed (item 6) | 1500 | 567 |
